name: Region settings
description: Optional settings for one navigation region. MSR 'Region settings'.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: region flags; 0x02 or 0x10 gives it its own edge BSP (stock mostly 1)

fields.name: link
fields.description: the region it joins into one area (0 = none)

fields.name: anchored
fields.description: non-zero: the region moves with the object found at this entry's position
